summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing completion of the second tranche and initiation of a third tranche of its multi-year share repurchase program. The second tranche, totaling approximately €249.999 million, was completed on August 28, 2026, with purchases on Euronext Milan and NYSE at average prices of €358.07 and $414.21 per share, respectively. The third tranche, up to €250 million, begins September 2, 2026, expected to end by December 16, 2026, funded from available cash. A non-discretionary buyback agreement for up to €200 million on EXM is included. Watch for execution pace and market impact.
